interface.signature: hex_string -> {r: int, g: int, b: int}

preconditions.description: The input must be a string.

preconditions.expression: len(hex_string) == 7 and hex_string[0] == '#' and all(c in '0123456789abcdefABCDEF' for c in hex_string[1:])
preconditions.description: The input string must be exactly 7 characters long, start with '#', and contain only valid hexadecimal characters.

postconditions.description: The output must be a dictionary with keys 'r', 'g', and 'b' corresponding to the red, green, and blue components of the color.
